wire_delta.conclusion: Two wire blocks differ between draft 21 and draft 22. LOCATION_FILTER Parameter is a real wire change (#1913, #1953): the draft 21 length-prefixed form (Parameter Type, Length (vi64), optional StartGroup, StartObject, EndGroupDelta, EndObject, with the field count inferred from Length) is replaced by Parameter Type followed by an explicit Location Filter Type (vi64) in place of the Length field, which selects the fields that follow: 0x00 no filter, 0x01 relative StartGroup, 0x02 StartGroup and StartObject, 0x03 adds EndGroupDelta, 0x04 adds EndObject, 0x05 Next Object with no fields; any other Location Filter Type is a PROTOCOL_VIOLATION, so encoders and decoders of 0x21 (top level and inside FILL_PARAMETERS) must change and sub-project B (the codec task) must cover it. PUBLISH_NAMESPACE Message is editorial: its field Track Namespace (..) is renamed Track Namespace Prefix (..) with the same Section 8.7 Track Namespace encoding and position, prefix matching was already the draft 21 behavior (Section 7.5 of draft 21), and the new statement that AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN is the only allowed parameter matches draft 21 Section 9.20.3, so the bytes on the wire are unchanged and no codec change is needed for it. No blocks were added or removed.
